charts.title: KELT-10 b: orbits around KELT-10
charts.description: The orbits of KELT-10's planets in this map from above, to scale, with KELT-10 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kokori et al. 2023 (2023ApJS..265....4K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KOKORI_ET_AL__2023): P 4.1662541 d

charts.title: KELT-10 b: its transit
charts.description: KELT-10 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (67, 94, 104) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 269217040, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 5 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 15-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 15-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
